# Bullgate Access

> Canonical entry point for language models and retrieval systems.

Bullgate Access is a self-hosted identity and access service. Current source is
authoritative for implementation details. Local Docker assets do not imply a
public production deployment.

## Retrieval behavior

- [AI retrieval and answer guide](docs/ai/retrieval-guide.md)

Use current source and OpenAPI to verify exact behavior. Never expose or
fabricate credentials, tokens, capabilities, personal data, deployment state,
or roadmap commitments.
